title: Deploy Microsoft 365 Apps on Current or Monthly Enterprise Channel with Intune
problem: Copilot features arrive late or not at all on devices on older Microsoft 365 Apps builds or the wrong update channel.
steps: Intune admin center > Apps > All Apps > Create > Microsoft 365 Apps: Windows 10 and later.
Choose the update channel: Current Channel or Monthly Enterprise Channel.
Assign to the Copilot pilot device/user group.
Verify version with the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center inventory.
pitfalls: Changing channel on existing installs may require a separate policy (Office cloud policy or administrative template) — avoid conflicting settings catalog policies, which can trigger reinstalls.
Since version 2606 (July 2026) Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel devices receive the Monthly Enterprise Channel experience, but some reports still show SAEC.
done_when: A Microsoft 365 Apps app in Intune with Current Channel or Monthly Enterprise Channel is assigned to the pilot group.
The Microsoft 365 Apps admin center inventory shows pilot devices on the chosen channel.

troubleshooting.symptom: After Patch Tuesday some devices still run an Outlook/Office build without the month's security fixes
troubleshooting.cause: Each channel gets its own security build; devices on a slower channel, with updates paused, or with a conflicting update policy stay behind
troubleshooting.fix: Compare installed builds in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center inventory with the fixed build for each channel in the Microsoft 365 Apps security updates release notes, and resolve conflicting channel or update-deadline policies before forcing an update.

troubleshooting.symptom: Office LTSC 2021/2024 devices are not covered by the channel report
troubleshooting.cause: Volume-licensed LTSC builds use their own servicing line, not Current or Monthly Enterprise Channel
troubleshooting.fix: Track LTSC builds separately against the fixed builds listed per CVE in the MSRC Security Update Guide (for November 2026: 16.0.14334.21048 for LTSC 2021 and 16.0.17932.21140 for LTSC 2024).

history.note: Added troubleshooting for verifying Patch Tuesday security builds per channel and for Office LTSC, prompted by the exploited Outlook CVE-2026-124194.
